title: Does Depot-medroxyprogesterone acetate affect ovary and uterine tube of white albino rat?
author: Samjhana Kumari Sharma
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qakdscw

steps.title: House and acclimate rats
steps.instruction: Obtain 30 healthy female Wistar Albino rats (150–200 g) from the BPKIHS animal house; feed standard pellet diet and water ad libitum; keep in a well‑ventilated room at 25 °C with a 12 h light‑dark cycle; house in polypropylene cages (40 × 25 × 15 cm) with paddy‑husk bedding changed every 4–5 days.

steps.title: Prepare DMPA dosing solution
steps.instruction: Dilute one vial of Pfizer DMPA (150 mg ml⁻¹ suspension) in distilled water to obtain the concentration required for a 2.4 mg intramuscular dose per rat per week.

steps.title: Assign groups and schedule injections
steps.instruction: Divide the 30 rats into two groups (n = 15 each): experimental group receives 2.4 mg DMPA intramuscularly once weekly for 8 weeks; control group receives 0.25 ml normal saline intramuscularly on the same schedule. Dose conversion follows the Paget and Barnes method.

steps.title: Anesthetize and perfuse animals
steps.instruction: One day after the 8‑week treatment, anesthetize each rat with ether soaked in cotton, then perform in‑vivo perfusion fixation of ovaries and uterine tubes.

steps.title: Isolate and post‑fix organs
steps.instruction: Using scalpel and forceps, isolate the ovaries and uterine tubes; post‑fix them in Bouin’s fluid for 24 h.

steps.title: Section and fix tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Cut each organ into ~3 mm pieces, then fix the pieces in neutral‑buffered formalin for 7 days.

steps.title: Process tissues for paraffin embedding
steps.instruction: Process the fixed pieces through the standard stages to produce paraffin blocks.

steps.title: Trim, section, and stain slides
steps.instruction: Trim the paraffin blocks, cut sections at 4 µm thickness, and stain with routine hematoxylin‑eosin (H&E).

steps.title: Microscopic examination
steps.instruction: Examine all stained sections under a light microscope.
